PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory:
In the HOENN region, there are three POKéMON that represent the power of rock, ice, and steel.
Each of them is said to hide away deep inside caves.
That's the story I heard when I was just a little kid.
PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenTh:
“Six dots open three doors.”
Grandpa used to say that, but I don't know what he meant.
